title.zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 系列模型并推出多项更新
title.en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 family models with multiple updates

current_state.zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 及智能界面（Intelligent UI），目前正分阶段推送给 ChatGPT 用户：Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 已在 Chat 标签页获得更新，Free 和 Go 层级次日跟进；Work 和 Codex 暂不在此次推送范围内。
current_state.en: OpenAI released GPT-6 with Intelligent UI and is rolling it out in stages to ChatGPT users: Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers received it in the Chat tab, with Free and Go tiers following the next day; Work and Codex are not part of this rollout.

updates.title_zh: 刚刚，GPT-6 Astra接上宇树G1，把厨房收拾了！
updates.title_en: 刚刚，GPT-6 Astra接上宇树G1，把厨房收拾了！
updates.what_changed_zh:
据媒体报道，新近发布的 GPT-6「Astra」模型接入宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人，通过把机器人技能当作可调用的工具，完成了一次厨房整理任务。该演示将各项机器人能力视为语言模型可以调用的工具，用以执行物理动作。

该演示体现了基于大模型的具身控制思路，即前沿模型通过与其调用软件时相同的工具调用接口来调度机器人的物理技能。

演示的任务是用宇树 G1 收拾厨房。目前该演示仅见于媒体报道，尚无独立的性能评测或成功率数据公布。
updates.what_changed_en: A newly reported GPT-6 'Astra' model was connected to a Unitree G1 humanoid robot and completed a kitchen cleanup task by invoking robot skills as tools.

updates.background_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是 OpenAI 开发的大语言模型。据维基百科，该模型于 2026 年 9 月 3 日先向获批用户开放，次日全面可用，相关报道强调其在计算机和浏览器中独立完成复杂任务的能力。宇树 G1 是宇树科技（Unitree Robotics）的人形机器人，官方介绍其结合力位混合控制与模仿学习、强化学习，可实现对物体的精细操作。具身智能（embodied AI）指通过传感器和模型在物理世界中学习并行动的系統。
updates.background_en: GPT-6 Astra is a large language model developed by OpenAI; according to Wikipedia it was initially released to approved users on September 3, 2026, with general availability the following day, and coverage highlighted its ability to carry out complex tasks on a computer and in a browser. The Unitree G1 is a humanoid robot from Unitree Robotics, which the company describes as combining force-position hybrid control with imitation and reinforcement learning for precise object manipulation. Embodied AI refers to systems that learn from and act in the physical world through sensors and models.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该演示没有直接涉及任何加密资产；潜在传导主要通过 AI 与机器人叙事情绪，影响 AI agent 及 DePIN／机器人相关代币板块的市场情绪，而非现金流或协议基本面。
updates.market_impact_en: No crypto asset is directly involved in this demonstration; any market transmission would run through sentiment toward AI-and-robotics narrative sectors, such as AI agent and DePIN/robotics-related tokens, rather than through cash flows or protocol fundamentals.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI 28天冲刺首日：GPT-6 Astra和6.1 Sol提速约50%
updates.title_en: OpenAI 28天冲刺首日：GPT-6 Astra和6.1 Sol提速约50%
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI 启动为期 28 天的产品冲刺，首日即为 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 带来约快 50% 的默认生成速度，并自动推送至 Codex、ChatGPT Work 以及通过“Sign in with ChatGPT”认证的第三方工具。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI kicked off its 28-day product sprint with Day 1 delivering roughly 50% faster default generation for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, automatically rolled out to Codex, ChatGPT Work, and third-party tools authenticated via 'Sign in with ChatGPT'.

updates.title_zh: ChatGPT的“智能界面”更新让回答中充满图片、图表和按钮
updates.title_en: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-6 与智能界面（Intelligent UI）已在 Chat 标签页面向 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 层级全球推送，Free 和 Go 层级次日跟进；该更新仅适用于 ChatGPT 聊天体验，Work 和 Codex 仍按各自独立路线推进。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI announced that GPT-6 with Intelligent UI began rolling out globally to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers in the Chat tab, with Free and Go tiers following the next day; the update applies to the ChatGPT chat experience while Work and Codex remain on separate tracks.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 及智能界面（Intelligent UI），目前正分阶段推送给 ChatGPT 用户：Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 已在 Chat 标签页获得更新，Free 和 Go 层级次日跟进；Work 和 Codex 暂不在此次推送范围内。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 with Intelligent UI and is rolling it out in stages to ChatGPT users: Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers received it in the Chat tab, with Free and Go tiers following the next day; Work and Codex are not part of this rollout.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
OpenAI正在ChatGPT中推出名为“智能界面”（Intelligent UI）的新功能，让助手在文字回答之外还能组合展示交互式示意图、图表、表单和可点击按钮。该功能与GPT-6一同发布，并称将覆盖所有用户。

这一变化改变了ChatGPT在整个平台上呈现回答的方式，使助手从纯文本输出转向针对具体任务的交互式结果，而不再只是用文字描述步骤。

据OpenAI公告，搭载智能界面的GPT-6率先在Chat标签页面向ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business和Enterprise用户全球推送，次日扩展至Free和Go层级；该更新适用于ChatGPT的聊天体验，Work和Codex目前仍走各自独立的路线。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
OpenAI is rolling out a new 'Intelligent UI' in ChatGPT that lets the assistant combine a text answer with interactive diagrams, charts, forms and tappable buttons. The feature is being released alongside GPT-6 and is described as reaching all users.

The change alters how ChatGPT renders its answers across the platform, moving the assistant from plain text toward task-specific interactive output rather than only describing steps in prose.

According to OpenAI's announcement, GPT-6 with Intelligent UI began rolling out globally to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers in the Chat tab, with Free and Go tiers following the next day; the update applies to the ChatGPT chat experience, while Work and Codex remain on separate tracks.
updates.background_zh: GPT-6是OpenAI在GPT-5系列之后推出的新一代主力模型。“智能界面”这一思路延续了生成式界面（generative UI）的概念，即由模型根据提示或上下文生成界面元素，而不仅仅是文字。
updates.background_en: GPT-6 is OpenAI's next major model in the GPT series, following the GPT-5 family. The 'Intelligent UI' concept extends the idea of generative UI, in which a model generates interface elements — not just text — in response to a prompt or context.
updates.market_impact_zh: ChatGPT是消费级AI的重要分发渠道，因此其平台层面转向可交互、可渲染的回答形式，主要通过情绪面对加密市场中的AI叙事板块产生关联，而非源于任何已公布的加密集成。现有材料中未提及直接的托管、流动性或链上关联。
updates.market_impact_en: ChatGPT is a major distribution channel for consumer AI, so a platform-wide shift toward interactive, rendered answers touches the AI-narrative segment of crypto markets mainly through sentiment rather than any announced crypto integration. No direct custody, liquidity or on-chain linkage is described in the available material.
